title: Inbound email: require SPF or DKIM pass before trusting the From address
description:
amplify/functions/ses-inbound-receive/handler.ts:125 authorises inbound email purely by looking up inbound.senderEmail against registered profiles. resolveFromSesMail (:367-398) reads only receipt.action.bucketName and objectKey and never reads receipt.spfVerdict, dkimVerdict, spamVerdict or virusVerdict. A spoofed From of any registered editor submits citations into the corpus and triggers the five-minute processor Lambda.

Fix: before the registered-sender lookup, reject (or mark unauthorized) when spfVerdict.status and dkimVerdict.status are both not PASS, and drop messages whose spamVerdict or virusVerdict is FAIL. Add unit cases to amplify/functions/shared/email-submission.test.mjs for a spoofed sender and for a passing sender.

Done when: the handler refuses a message with SPF and DKIM FAIL from a registered address, and the existing happy path still passes.

Source: full code review of develop @ e9b1923 on 2026-10-17 (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/f01a3c9f-7fad-4df2-8a15-ac6c27cc83ed). Branch from origin/develop, name the branch after this issue, open a PR into develop, and record branch, PR link and verification in a comment here before closing.
